# Diagnostic Code Registry

<!-- Generated by cargo run -p sifr_diagnostics --bin gen-error-docs. Do not edit by hand. -->

This file is generated from `crates/sifr_diagnostics/src/codes.rs`.

Codes use per-family local numbering. `SIFR-<FAMILY>-0000` is reserved as the family base and must never be emitted.

Registry states:

- `Active`: may have a `DiagnosticCode` constant and can be emitted.
- `Reserved`: allocated for a future or structural purpose and cannot be emitted.

Tooling metadata defaults: `tool_actions` is empty, `fix_all_eligible` is `false`, and machine-applicable suggestion availability is derived from emitted suggestions rather than authored manually.
